note: docs/14 §8: savecleanupaggressive (kSaveCleanupAggressive, off) and the save cleanup as one spread pass (SaveCleanupSpread.cs). Built 2026-10-30, never run. Day run, stop on any FAIL, crash or ScriptError from our code (triage against the change ledger first). Job 1 builds the scratch multi-generation save MultiGen-Test-BP from Baseline-BP (Baseline-BP is never overwritten); jobs 2-5 need it. Job 2 = off/on in one load + save matrix (new, overwrite, unpaused, build mode, reload + play, save after reload); after it compare sizes: node tools/harness/save-stats.ts MultiGen-BP-off MultiGen-BP-aggr. Job 4 = hitch A/B in one load, judged with node tools/harness/hitch-ab.ts (pass: no new frames >= 100 ms in on slices, savecleanup_spread_max_slice_us <= ~3000). Job 3 = rotation: two households played in turn, the played set across save + reload, no aggressive action on a played household (logForbid on the per-action log lines, every job). Job 5 = Isla Paradiso second world on the off/on repro's first half (no multi-generation material there: checks the spread pass and the basic parts on a natural save).

jobs.note: Builds MultiGen-Test-BP (repro bp-multigen-build, ~22 min): elders made friends of the active Sim then aged to death, children aged up, a birth (optional), 5 min at ultra. Pass: final count line shows buried >= 3 and removable outfits > 0; the save exists; no crash or ScriptError. If buried is 0 the deaths did not finish within the waits: raise the age_up waitS, not the cleanup

Off/on + save matrix (14 min): repro bp-multigen-aggr on MultiGen-Test-BP. Pass: savecleanup_spread_passes >= 2, savecleanup_spread_refused 0, savecleanup_spread_max_slice_us <= ~3000, savecleanupaggressive_* > 0 on the first pass and ~0 more on the second, every save ok within 120 s, reload reaches live mode with the active household intact, MultiGen-BP-aggr smaller than MultiGen-BP-off (save-stats.ts); no crash, hang, ScriptError or ts3native.log FAIL line

Rotation (10 min): repro bp-multigen-rotation on MultiGen-Test-BP. Pass: played_households 2 before and after the reload, read back from the sidecar file, not the save (logRequire: native "played: <key>: 2 households read" after the reload, "played: added hh=", and the Save As copy "played: N households copied from"), played_households_added >= 1, pass finishes, no ts3native.log line with tier=aggr and near=1 (logForbid: any aggressive action on a played household within kPlayedGenerations = FAIL), saves ok, no ScriptError

Hitch A/B in one load (10 min, 2-min slices) on MultiGen-Test-BP: savecleanup + savecleanupaggressive alternating, natural 2:00 alarm fires only (a pass decides its parts when it starts; one started in an on slice may finish in the next). Pass: hitch-ab.ts shows no more frames >= 100 ms in on slices than off slices, worst-hitches.ts --min 100 has no iteration led by SaveCleanupSpreadRun, savecleanup_spread_max_slice_us <= ~3000
Second world (14 min): repro bp-multigen-aggr on Baseline-IP (saves keep the MultiGen-BP-* names; few dead Sims there). Same pass rules as bp-multigen-aggr except the per-part counts may be 0
